_metadata.description: API, CLI, and UI expose the same registration/destination/plan/run/restore model over one Connect-RPC contract.

requirements.title: Connect-RPC API contract
requirements.description: All operations (register/deregister targets, manage destinations/plans, trigger runs, restore/verify, query catalog/health) are exposed via Connect-RPC defined in packages/proto/schemas/data-backup-manager/v1.

validation.notes: Assert the mounted Connect-RPC endpoint registry stays aligned with the generated proto service procedures.

requirements.title: CLI surface for operators and self-registration
requirements.description: The CLI wraps the API so scenarios can self-register targets at setup/lifecycle (e.g. data-backup-manager register ...) and operators can manage destinations/plans, trigger runs, and restore.

validation.notes: Assert the CLI exposes the target, destination, discovery, coverage, plan, run, and restore command groups.

requirements.title: First-backup coverage activation
requirements.description: CoverageService reports first-backup readiness (registered vs recommended vs sensitive targets, plus planned/backed-up/verified posture) and bulk-registers non-sensitive discovered durable targets; sensitive credential/token targets require explicit opt-in. Plan create/update is guarded against incomplete non-sensitive default coverage unless allow_incomplete_coverage is set. Surfaced across API, CLI (coverage group), and UI (coverage banner).

validation.notes: Coverage report classification + dry-run/idempotency/partial-failure of bulk accept; plan guard tested in api/internal/plans/coverage_guard_test.go.
Register-recommended action, sensitive opt-in, and the plans incomplete-coverage proceed path (ui/src/features/plans/PlanFormDialog.test.tsx).

requirements.title: UI for destinations, plans, runs, storage, restore
requirements.description: The UI presents destinations (with storage usage vs cap), plans, run history with status, and a guided restore/verify flow, using platform design tokens and WCAG AA patterns.

validation.notes: Current UI smoke coverage renders mocked health, coverage, target status, destination, and discovery surfaces. A dedicated guided restore UI test remains planned.
